name: IEC 60309 16 A 2P+E 6h (blue)
description: Industrial pin-and-sleeve accessory with two poles and earth, 16 A, colour-coded blue for 200–250 V. The earth contact sits at the 6 h position of the clock system, aligned with the major keyway.

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase
conditions: Looking into the socket-outlet, the line (P1) is the pole next to the earth contact clockwise and the second pole (P2) follows (Mennekes front view, Wikipedia).
P2 is the neutral or a second line depending on the installation, so its function is not recorded.

sources.note: Front-view figure of the socket contact arrangement (2P+E, 3P+E, 3P+N+E); facts only, no image reused.

notes: The socket-outlet and connector face is drawn from the Mennekes front-view figure of the 2P+E contact arrangement (earth at 6 h, pole marked L/+ upper left) and the Wikipedia caption 'clockwise from bottom: PE, L, N'; P1 is placed at the position both sources give to the line. Contact angles and pitch-circle diameter are not dimensioned by these sources (schematic drawing).

No plug or appliance-inlet drawing: no cited source depicts the pin face with the poles identified (sources only state that the pins are arranged the opposite way, which would mean deriving the face by mirroring).

The line position (next to the earth clockwise, looking into the socket-outlet) comes from the Mennekes figure and Wikipedia; the IEC 60309-2 sheets were not reviewed to confirm it. The drawing labels the poles P1/P2 as stored in the data.
The IEC 60309-2 standard sheets were not reviewed; ratings come from a manufacturer datasheet.
